items.text: Saquon Barkley active for MNF vs DAL after hamstring absence; postgame said hamstring 'came out great' and back issue (from compensating) shouldn't keep him out. Limited snaps but efficient (62 rush yds + TD).
items.why: Schefter confirmation of active + Barkley quotes on hamstring/back.
items.implication: Cleared short-term but workload managed; monitor Week 8 practice for full return.
items.opportunity: Primary back when healthy; backups limited by IR.

items.text: ETR weekend injury summary: GTD/OPTIMISM Puka Nacua; GTD/PESSIMISM Breece Hall; IN Josh Jacobs, Jonah Coleman, Christian Kirk, Jordan Mason, Tank Dell; EXPECTED TO PLAY Saquon Barkley; OUT Lamar Jackson, DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks. Late watching Gibbs ankle, CMC, Skattebo hamstring.
items.why: Gold-standard weekend GTD/IN/OUT lists from ETR practice and beat reports.
items.implication: Start/sit pivots and handcuff activations for Week 7; monitor Gibbs/CMC late.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries for OUT WRs in PHI; Jacobs full role return.

items.text: Zay Flowers leads NFL in yards per route run despite 64% targets from Huntley; Ravens 6th in YPP with Huntley 50% snaps. Excited for Declan Doyle + healthy Lamar Jackson cooking.
items.why: Levitan efficiency data + Lamar return upside.
items.implication: Flowers WR1 ceiling spikes with Lamar; stash/start with confidence Week 8+.

items.text: Jonah Coleman (first game back) led Broncos backfield: 50% snaps, 41% rush share, 34% routes. J.K. Dobbins only 21% snaps; RJ Harvey fluky long receiving TD.
items.implication: Coleman clear lead if healthy; Dobbins/Harvey committee demotion; waiver priority on Coleman.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitomizes high-value-touch thesis: worst efficiency runner (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 full-PPR via 9 carries inside-5 and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan data on goal-line and target volume overriding poor YPC/EPA.
items.implication: Sustainable RB2/flex floor via opportunity even if efficiency stays poor; buy if discounted.
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics conflict with volume-based ranking.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey suffered a mild hamstring strain (initially called quad/thigh) in Week 7 vs ATL, returned to game; Shanahan 'pretty optimistic' he will be fine coming out of 49ers bye for Week 9.
items.why: Shanahan confirmation and optimism post-game evaluation.
items.implication: Hold through bye; low risk of multi-week absence; monitor handcuff Kaelon Black.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected Week 9 vs LV if no setback.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Jahmyr Gibbs (ankle turned on purposeful slide), CMC (quad returned), Jaylen Waddle (shoulder), Aaron Jones (knee), Cam Skattebo (hamstring), others.
items.implication: Gibbs almost certainly fine per later Levitan; confirm Week 8 status.

items.text: When talking workhorse RBs we are NOT talking about Bucky Irving enough.
items.why: Berry emphatic workhorse call on Pregame/FFHappyHour.
items.implication: Start with confidence; RB1 upside in TB backfield.
items.opportunity: Implied high snap/carry share as true workhorse.

items.text: Lions full-PPR PPG: Goff QB2 (behind Allen), Gibbs RB1 (3.9 clear of Walker), Amon-Ra WR4 (behind JSN/Puka/Lamb), LaPorta TE6, Jameson Williams WR24. Zero surprise given defense/schedule/talent.
items.implication: Start all Lions skill with confidence; Gibbs clear RB1.

items.text: Ravens first-round G Vega Ioane suffered MCL sprain vs Bengals; short-term injury, will miss a little time. One of NFL's best rookies.
items.implication: OL impact for Lamar/Ravens run/pass; monitor backup play.

items.text: Josh Jacobs is BACK. Discussing fantasy value going forward for Packers RB rest of season.
items.why: Berry ROS value discussion on Pregame after Jacobs IN/active.
items.implication: Solid RB2 ROS in GB; start confidently.

items.text: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name?
items.why: Berry respect/upgrade call post strong performance.
items.implication: WR2/3 with WR1 weeks; hold or buy low if undervalued.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Jaylin Noel 15 (left early turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (first game since 2024).
items.why: Levitan route counts confirm Nico dominance; Dell limited return.
items.implication: Nico locked WR1; Dell handcuff/stash only until ramp-up.

items.text: Vikings RB Aaron Jones’ knee injury from Sunday vs Colts not considered significant; source describes him as 'day to day'.
